body:
Hey beloved… I’m Aaron, an East London native … I’m currently a Lead UX designer at Globant.

Hey beloved I’m Aaron, an East London native and I’ve been in the design industry for the last 10 years… I’m currently a Lead UX designer at Globant.

I’ve worked with a variety of industries, ranging from agencies through to global conglomerates. I value creativity, thinking outside-of-the-box and having a strong team morale. That’s how magic gets made.

I've handled quite a variety of projects, from the ambiguous “build me an app” to a clear set of fixed requirements that all need to be delivered tomorrow. Ambiguity is never the enemy.
